description.title: Description
enum: AB10 - Transaction interrupted due to an error in the payer user's participant.
AC05 - Paying user's transactional account closed.
AC06 - The transactional account of the paying user is blocked

AG12 - It is not allowed to send the request for scheduling pain.013 for a transactional account in the same institution or in a participant that uses the settlement service of the same settling participant in SPI.
AM02 - Charge amount exceeds the maximum value set by the payer user.
AM09 - The amount charged does not correspond to the amount established in the claim.
AM13 - The sum of the taxes entered results in an invalid value (greater than the transaction value).
CRNC - Receiver user document number does not match the data contained in the recurrence/authorization
DENC - CPF/CNPJ of the paying user does not match the data contained in the recurrence/authorization.
DS27 - Participant is not registered or has not yet started operations on SPI.
DTED - Discrepancy between the informed due date and the recurrence periodicity and/or product rules.
DTNT - New post-due date scheduling attempts are not allowed beyond the business rule limit (from D+8, considering D0 as the due date).
FCD1 - Pain.013 was received more than 10 days before the scheduled settlement date, in violation of the business rules.
FCD2 - Pain.013 was received less than 2 days before the scheduled settlement date, in violation of the business rules.
GRER - The reason for the generic/miscellaneous error is used only when there is no other applicable domain.
IRNT - Recurring billing does not allow new scheduling attempts after the due date (recurrence ID with characteristics that do not allow new attempts).
MIDI - Recurrence ID does not exist or is incorrect.
MSUC - StatusRecurrence other than CFDB (confirmed by the paying user).
NIEC - New payment instruction is invalid because the same charge already has a scheduled payment order pending submission to SPI for settlement.
NIPA - New payment instruction is invalid, payment has already been made.
NITX - New payment instruction does not correspond to a previously generated recurring charge (different Receiver Reconciliation Id). Only used for 'NTAG' and 'RIFL' scheduling purposes.
QUNT - Number of new post-due date scheduling attempts exceeds the limit defined by the business rule (more than 3 attempts within 7 days after the due date, considering D0 as the due date).
RC09 - Invalid or non-existent ISPB of the paying user participant.
RR06 - The element block can only be filled when the payer's CPF/CNPJ and payee's CPF/CNPJ fields are both for Legal Entities (14 characters).
UDEI - Debtor document number is incorrect.
ACCT - Closing the transactional account of the paying user or the receiving user
BLCK - Bocking of the paying user's or receiving user's transactional account
FAIL - Due to failure or error in the settlement flow
OTHR - Requested by the paying user participant or the receiving user participant, for other reasons
SLCR - Requested by the receiving user
SLDB - Requested by the paying user
SLBD - Requested by the receiving user

attempts.description: Settlement attempts. If some error occurs during the settlement process, the reason code and description will be filled with the pix-out error code and description (can be found here: https://developers.pismo.io/pismo-docs/reference/post-pix-out-transfer)
